description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Puttalam Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Puttalam Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a deceased member, including the nomination procedure by a political party and the formal declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically covering candidate nominations and declarations as outlined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
